propositions: A read-only derivation reader must compute llm_call_proxy and latency metrics by summing REVIEW_RESULT.metrics fields (llm_calls, det_ms, llm_ms, total_ms) across a range, never from COMPLETION_VERDICT which carries no metrics block.

Cost-per-accepted-change is defined as total llm_calls from REVIEW_RESULT divided by the count of completion_verifier_pass_v1 records (accepted closes); it must return None (Unavailable) when zero accepted closes exist to prevent division by zero.

First-pass-verification must compute the fraction of tickets whose earliest COMPLETION_VERDICT record (by chronological filename order) is a completion_verifier_pass_v1, distinguishing first-attempt passes from retries.

Environment-diagnosis-interval must pair each gate_error_v1 ERROR record with the next PASS record for the same gate (matched by the ERROR's gate field: plan_review, code_review, or completion) on that ticket's stream, computing interval as PASS.timestamp − ERROR.timestamp; unpaired ERRORs represent open intervals.

The reader must perform a single raw ordered scan of each ticket's *-REVIEW_RESULT.json and *-COMPLETION_VERDICT.json event files (sorted by ns-epoch filename prefix / event_sort_key) without using schema-guarded helpers, reading schema from data.schema/data.verdict to distinguish plan_review_result_v2, completion_verifier_pass_v1/_fail_v1, and gate_error_v1 records.
All metrics must register into src/rebar/metrics/registry.py with source='sidecar' and confidence='high', asserting is_authoritative('sidecar') as True.
